programme.title: Thicker Than Water
programme.desc: Brand new series: Walter Presents - which showcases the best foreign language drama from around the world - features this darkly atmospheric Swedish series in which a mother reunites her three adult children and forces them to confront the family secrets buried in their past. A beautiful island in the Swedish Alandic archipelago is home to a popular lodge, run by Anna-Lisa Waldemar and her youngest son Oskar. Mysteriously, Anna-Lisa has summoned her eldest son Lasse and her daughter Jonna home - it's the first time the family have been together in years. Despite the idyllic setting, the homecoming is full of conflict, arousing old memories, resentments and secrets. No one knows why they have been brought back and all three siblings are keen for the weekend to be over. However, her children are unaware that Anna-Lisa has a hidden agenda and a plan that is set to change their lives for ever. Starring Joel Spira, Bjorn Bengtsson, Aliette Opheim, Stina Ekblad, Torkel Pettersson, Jessica Grabowsky, Saga Sarkola, Molly Nutley and Tobias Zilliacus. In Swedish with English subtitles.

They are mobile, carnivorous, intelligent, and wreak havoc wherever they go. Starring Joely Richardson, Brian Cox, Vanessa Redgrave and Eddie Izzard.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Bayern" - "Monaco"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Crvena Zvezda" - "Maccabi"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Eurolygos rungtynės. "Baskonia" - "Barcelona"
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Hostile Planet
programme.desc: Delve beneath the surface of the largest habitat on Earth - our oceans - to uncover a world of extraordinary extremes from crushing depths to stormy coasts and vast blue deserts to crowded reefs. Oceans are dynamic environments where animals must adapt to life of constant change. Discover how seals fend off sharks; how turtles risk their lives to create their next generation; and how ingenious orca fight to survive in the face of ever-increasing competition.

programme.title: Reptile Planet
programme.desc: Skittering, swimming and even gliding, over 12,000 species of reptiles roam the world. Crocs, turtles, snakes and lizards have ancestors as old as the dinosaurs and evolution as their friend. These cold-blooded creatures have adapted in clever and lethal ways, from armoured skin and poisonous venom to record-breaking bite force and even blood squirting eyes. This is Reptile Planet!

programme.title: Day of the Dragon
programme.desc: The clock starts just before sunrise - when the temperature begins to rise. It's hard work being the world's biggest lizard on Rinca island. Competition is so fierce he can't afford to slow down. For the biggest male on the island, an ever- warming environment and shrinking hunting grounds threaten his survival across every hour of the day.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin dares into the Australian savannah to find the species most built to survive. First is Australia's largest bird of prey, the majestic but intimidating wedge-tailed eagle. Next, Phil tracks down one of the world's deadliest snakes, the coastal taipan. Finally, Phil faces the uniquely Australian frill-necked lizard, a reptile with fascinating defense mechanisms.

programme.title: Built to Survive
programme.desc: Indigenous educator Phil Breslin heads into the mangroves to discover which animal is truly built to survive the mud and muck. He encounters a feisty mud crab with huge pincers and catches a shovel-nosed ray with his bare hands. Finally, Phil faces a creature we all love to hate—the mosquito—and discovers there's more to these tiny bloodsuckers than meets the eye.

programme.title: Leopard & Hyena: Strange Alliance
programme.desc: After an explosive chance encounter, a lone male hyena and a female leopard join forces, and an unconventional hunting partnership blossoms.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Sharks of the North
programme.desc: Sightings of great white sharks have been on the rise in Atlantic Canada. Alanna Canaran, a passionate science educator and dive instructor, embarks on a mission to unravel the enigmas surrounding these magnificent creatures and is determined to dispel fear of sharks in Nova Scotians. As the journey unfolds, Canaran and her team dive into the history of human-shark relationships along the coast. Facing numerous challenges, including elusive sharks and treacherous weather conditions, the team perseveres. With sheer determination and a stroke of luck, they gather invaluable knowledge of these magnificent creatures, contributing to a better understanding of white sharks in Canada.

programme.title: Big Cat Planet
programme.desc: Big cats may seem like the ultimate wildlife cliche, but they're locked in a global battle for survival. Powerful and dangerous, they now clash with humans more than ever. This sweeping safari reveals their resilience and adaptability. Cheetahs hunt from cars, jaguars stalk prey underwater and around boats, and India's lions prowl city streets. Familiar species and behaviors take on new drama, with revelations that reaffirm why big cats remain nature's most formidable predators.

Deep dive into the fascinating science of an underwater world where nothing is off the menu, whether it's big game like hippos, crocs and humans, or inanimate objects like kayaks, cages and chicken coops.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

He gets close to a mother caring for her tiny cubs and a young group of males executing phenomenal hunts as a team, and learns about the unexpected challenges the species face.

programme.title: Rare Cat Skills
programme.desc: Rare wild cats showcase extraordinary skills for survival. Over millennia, each species evolved with unique adaptations to suit their environment. The Pallas's cat blends into China's rocky steppes, the black panther hunts in India's forest shadows, and the snow leopard scales icy Himalayan peaks. Every camouflage trick, extraordinary skill and heightened sense are their keys to survival.

programme.title: Leopard Kingdom
programme.desc: Karula, the Queen of Djuma, reigned over South Africas Sabi Sand for over a decade. But now, the queen is gone. Her offspring now hope to claim the land that was once hers.

programme.title: Diary of A Teen Leopard
programme.desc: Pemba is a Mamma's Boy! At two-years old, he should be independent, but he's still living at home! Like most teenagers, he's impatient and headstrong, which makes him bad at stalking and hunting, so Mom provides all their meals. But when Mom is injured Pemba is forced to grow up fast in order to survive! Can he sever those apron strings and face his fears to launch into adulthood?

programme.title: Mashatu: Land of Leopards
programme.desc: In Botswana's Mashatu Game Reserve, one of the last sanctuaries for free-roaming leopards, a mother gives birth to two cubs. She'll stop at nothing to protect them. But as climate change tightens its grip, resources dwindle, and a fierce leopard war looms. Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Jaguar: Jungle Icon of Guyana
programme.desc: A young jaguar is about to embark on the most important mission of his life, : to strike out and find a kingdom of his own. His journey will take him through varied habitats, each with its own cast of animals. Only if he can prove his worth will the jaguar be able to claim his throne in one of the last truly wild paradises on the planet.

programme.title: Serengeti Speed Queen
programme.desc: Nzuri is the Speed Queen of the Serengeti - but being fast isn't enough. She's constantly bullied by hyenas on the grassland and hunted by lions in the marsh. When two of her cubs are killed, the family is exiled to the transition forest. There, she learns to adapt her hunting methods and adds strategy to speed in order to outwit her enemies and steer her remaining cubs successfully to adulthood.

Over three years of intimate observation, this film unveils rare, breathtaking footage of behaviors never before documented, offering an unprecedented glimpse into the resilience and secrets of this elusive species.

programme.title: Rare Cat Skills
programme.desc: Rare wild cats showcase extraordinary skills for survival. Over millennia, each species evolved with unique adaptations to suit their environment. The Pallas's cat blends into China's rocky steppes, the black panther hunts in India's forest shadows, and the snow leopard scales icy Himalayan peaks. Every camouflage trick, extraordinary skill and heightened sense are their keys to survival.

programme.title: Leopard & Hyena: Strange Alliance
programme.desc: After an explosive chance encounter, a lone male hyena and a female leopard join forces, and an unconventional hunting partnership blossoms.

programme.title: Leopard Kingdom
programme.desc: Karula, the Queen of Djuma, reigned over South Africas Sabi Sand for over a decade. But now, the queen is gone. Her offspring now hope to claim the land that was once hers.

programme.title: Diary of A Teen Leopard
programme.desc: Pemba is a Mamma's Boy! At two-years old, he should be independent, but he's still living at home! Like most teenagers, he's impatient and headstrong, which makes him bad at stalking and hunting, so Mom provides all their meals. But when Mom is injured Pemba is forced to grow up fast in order to survive! Can he sever those apron strings and face his fears to launch into adulthood?

programme.title: Leopard & Hyena: Strange Alliance

programme.title: Sharks of the North
programme.desc: Sightings of great white sharks have been on the rise in Atlantic Canada. Alanna Canaran, a passionate science educator and dive instructor, embarks on a mission to unravel the enigmas surrounding these magnificent creatures and is determined to dispel fear of sharks in Nova Scotians. As the journey unfolds, Canaran and her team dive into the history of human-shark relationships along the coast. Facing numerous challenges, including elusive sharks and treacherous weather conditions, the team perseveres. With sheer determination and a stroke of luck, they gather invaluable knowledge of these magnificent creatures, contributing to a better understanding of white sharks in Canada.

programme.title: Prairie Dog Manor
programme.desc: Follow the exploits of these cute creatures from northern New Mexico. "Prairie Dog Manor" showcases the unique behaviour of these special animals and highlights the different relationships that exist between the clan members from Valles Caldera National Preserve. Beginning with the prairie dogs preparing for the coming winter, Carl and the pups get ready for hibernation. But they face danger from an unlikely source as deadly predators forge an alliance to threaten every dog in the territory. Further episodes explore the mating season when the warm weather arrives and battles commence between the males to earn the right to mate with the females. Soon, the females are pregnant and new pups arrive and the whole cycle starts again.

programme.title: Africa's Hidden Wonders
programme.desc: A land full of extreme environments and teeming with iconic wildlife, Africa holds a fascination like no other continent. This series takes the viewer on a journey from harsh desert landscapes to towering peaks, and from vast, sprawling grasslands to raging river torrents. The three episodes cover the mist-covered jungles and mountains of Rwanda and the great apes who call it home; the largest desert in the world, the Sahara, where the scarcity of water and food make life a daily challenge for the creatures who compete for them; and the cradle of humanity, Ethiopia, a weather-ravaged land full of natural beauty and unique wildlife.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: The story here examines the tactics used by a pride of South African lions as they hunt three distinct prey animals in the Singita Game Reserve. We'll analyze the Pride's unique strategies as they pursue zebra, impala, and ultimately the tallest land animal, the giraffe.

programme.title: Man v Lion
programme.desc: Fourth generation big cat tracker Boone Smith has worked in the harshest conditions imaginable, tracking the most elusive cats on the planet. But now he has a new mission that will bring us closer to the action than ever before. In Man v. Lion, only an inch of acrylic will separate Boone from one of the worlds top predators, bringing audiences closer to the African lion than they could ever imagine. The show follows Boone across the Nambiti Game Reserve as he breaks down each stage of a lion's kill. Boone tracks a lion coalition as they hunt and search for a mate, ultimately putting him face-to-face with these apex predators.

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

Last but certainly not least, Phil finds the iconic, cuddly and oh-so-sleepy koala.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Ultimate Animals Compilations
programme.desc: They are the backbone of the natural world, and in this documentary series, we explore some of the most interesting and amazing animals that roam our planet. Each episode focusses on two special creatures, revealing their characteristics and behaviours, and feature interviews with various experts alongside stunning video footage of the animals in their natural environments. A fascinating series that explores the animals' instincts and anatomies using state-of-the-art cameras and graphics, the creatures featured include polar bears, tigers, octopuses, elephants and orangutans.

programme.title: Wild, Smart and Deadly

programme.title: The Incredible Dr. Pol
programme.desc: Reality show follows Dutch-born veterinarian Jan Pol, his family and employees' everyday. Jan Pol and his wife Diane started their own practice in Weidman, Michigan, Pol Veterinary Services, back in in 1981. Dr Pol takes a good care of every family pet and head of livestock no matter what size or condition and is a true legend in the community. Dr Pol has seen it all, treating numerous patients every single day, his daily routine is more than 12 hours but nothing can stop him from being devoted to his patients.

programme.title: Bubble Guppies
programme.desc: The series Bubble Guppies revolves around the underwater adventures of a group of mermaid-like preschoolers who life in the fictional underwater city of Bubbletucky. The episode starts with a sketch of Molly saying "Hi, it's me Molly and it's time for-" only to be stopped by Gil doing the subject of the show. When Gil or Molly says "It's time for Bubble Guppies!", the theme song starts. After the theme song, the Little Fish say the episode's name. Something happens when a character goes to school. After that, the school day begins and the Bubble Guppies say "Good morning, Mr. Grouper!". Later, the remaining Guppie tells Mr. Grouper about what happened earlier. He states "Let's think about it," and the characters discuss the topic. The pop song for the episode then begins.One of the Guppies will go to a shop that mostly focuses on the topic. The owner of the shop will asks questions about what he or she needs. Later, Mr. Grouper comes into the shop and says it's time for lunch, and the "Lunchtime" song plays. At lunch the characters make a food joke about the subject of the episode. After lunch, another Gil and Molly sketch is shown. The Guppies do something fun which leads Mr. Grouper talking more about the topic, which leads into a dancing song. Mr. Grouper then says it's time to go outside, the "Outside" song plays, and the Guppies make up a story about the topic. After this, Gil and Molly do another sketch.The Guppies go on a field trip that focuses on the topic, and the show concludes with the last Gil and Molly sketch and a shorter version of the theme song.

programme.title: Breadwinners
programme.desc: Two ducks with thin legs and round faces, SwaySway and Buhdeuce, are best friends. They fly around the water-based planet Pondgea in a rocket-powered van and deliver fresh bread to its citizens. They often find themselves in awkward and funny situations, and sometimes their workdays are quite dangerous. They find new friends, deal with opponents and have fun, making sure Pondgea always receive fresh bread on time.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Ronnie Anne Santiago, her big brother Bobby and their mum have recently moved to Great Lakes City and are now getting used to life in this busy, and sometimes chaotic, new town. Here in the big city they meet the Casagrandes – their extended family made up of grandparents, aunt, uncle, cousins and their pets. Along with a bunch of friends they all live as one big happy family. Skateboarding Ronnie Anne also starts to explore what their new hometown has to offer. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

programme.title: The Loud House
programme.desc: In this crowded and chaotic household, Lincoln Loud is the only boy among his ten sisters. With eleven children under one roof, things get a little bit crazy sometimes, to say the least. This children's cartoon is fun and light-hearted, and Clyde, Lincoln's best friend, only adds to that. Clyde is an only child by contrast, and is jealous of Lincoln's abundance of siblings. Clyde also has a massive crush on Lori, who is Lincoln's oldest sister. However, she has a boyfriend, Bobby. Bobby, although not being particularly intelligent, has several different jobs, ranging from life guard, to security at a shopping centre.

programme.title: The Fairly OddParents
programme.desc: The Fairly OddParents tells us a story of Timmy Turner, a 10-year-old boy in the fictional town of Dimmsdale. Vicky is his babysitter with vicious temper. His parents are completely indifferent to him. His life is very sad and hopeless until his fairy godparents Wanda and Cosmo apperar in the fishbowl and try to fulfill his every wish. Timmy's greenness in making his wishes causes troubles and he has to "unwish" them together with his fairy godparents to avoid possible disasters. Enjoy Timmy's fantastic adventures in the world of fairies, dragons, unicorns and dwarfs.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: The Penguins of Madagascar is an American animated television series, a spin-off of the Madagascar films. The main characters are penguins-commandoes: Skipper, Rico, Kowalski, and Private. They pretend to be white and fluffy but in reality are fearless adrenaline addicts and a secret spy team on a mission to protect their home in the Central Park Zoo. The penguins often have to deal with problems caused by their zoo lemur neighbors- King Julien XIII, Maurice and Mort. The penguins thwart any attempts of King Julien XIII to wield the sceptre of the Zoo.

programme.title: The Penguins of Madagascar
programme.desc: Feline Fervor: King Julien is literally bounced out of his kingdom and onto the New York streets. A kindly old lady thinks he's a cat and swoops him up. He's encroaching on another's turf, though - the apartment's already home to a feline-impersonator, a female ferret named Zoe. Julien is taken with Zoe, and puts on his best seduction moves. But, unlike their friends and neighbours, Best and Bester have the unique ability to choose a new body every single day and, in doing so, experience life in a completely different way.

programme.title: Harvey Beaks
programme.desc: Welcome to the peck-uliar world of Harvey Beak, a moderately mellow young bird who flies around his magical forest home of Littlebark Grove, with best-bird friends Fee and Foo, a pair of boisterous twins. The three feathered friends are always looking for new things to do, zooming around the forest embarking on adventures. With many other animals living in the forest, there's plenty of new characters and creatures for the trio to meet, often involving them on their mischievous escapades. Harvey lives with his parents, Irving Beaks and Miriam Beaks.

programme.title: Wallykazam!
programme.desc: Wallykazam! follows the adventures of a troll named Wally and his pet dragon, Norville, who live in a forest with giants, goblins, ogres, sprites and other mythical creatures. Wally uses his magic stick to make words come to life on screen that start with a specific letter, sound or rhyme. Each episode features a new set of magic words that Wally uses to playfully transform the world around him.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Meet Bloom, a girl from Earth, who after she finds out that she is a fairy joins Alfea College on the planet Magix- a magical universe that is inhabited by fairies, witches and other mythical creatures. At Alfea College, fairy warriors from all over the universe study to improve their supernatural powers and here Bloom befriends five other fairies - Stella, the fairy of the Sun, Flora, the fairy of nature, Tecna, the fairy of technology, Musa, the fairy of music and Aisha, the fairy of waves. Together, this group of girls known as the Winx, become best friends and the force to be reckoned with as they experience incredible adventures while defending their universe from varous enemies.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Avatar: The Last Airbender is an American animated TV series, set in an Asiatic-like world. Some people there can manipulate the classical elements with psychokinetic variants of the Chinese martial arts. Unlike anybody else, 12-year-old Aang, the Avatar and last survivor of his nation, the Air Nomads, is capable of bending all four elements, his mission is to maintain harmony between the world's four nations. His flying bison Appa and friends Sokka, Katara, and later on Toph, are by his side on this challenging assignment.

programme.title: The Casagrandes
programme.desc: Family-orientated cartoon for kids. Meanwhile, Bobby helps his grandfather Hector working in the family store where they meet lots of interesting characters from the neighbourhood.

La dottoressa Ryan Stone e' alla sua prima missione spaziale, l'astronauta Matt Kowalsky e' alla guida dello shuttle per l''ultima volta, prima di ritirarsi in pensione. Un viaggio tranquillo che si trasforma presto in una catastrofe quando un esplosione distrugge la navicella causando la morte di tutti gli altri membri dell'equipaggio. I due astronauti vengono proiettati nello spazio profondo, senza alcun contatto con la Terra, apparentemente senza possibilita' di salvarsi.

programme.title: J. Edgar
programme.desc: Leonardo DiCaprio nell'ennesimo capolavoro di Clint Eastwood, che entra nel cuore della storia americana raccontando la chiacchierata vita di J. Edgar Hoover: leggendario capo dell'FBI per quasi 50 anni, dal 1924 al 1972, sotto ben otto presidenti degli Stati Uniti. Il ritratto pubblico e privato di un uomo, e della sua strenua lotta contro la criminalità e il mondo dei gangster. Un uomo, considerato il più potente d'America, che non si fermò davanti a nulla pur di proteggere il proprio Paese. Anche a costo di infrangere ogni regola, scritta e non.

programme.title: The Way Back
programme.desc: Peter Weir racconta un'impresa disperata in un film con Jim Sturgess, Ed Harris e Colin Farrell. Evasi da un lager siberiano, un gruppo di uomini intraprende una fuga in condizioni estreme.

programme.title: Potere assoluto
programme.desc: Clint Eastwood dirige e interpreta, al fianco di Gene Hackman, un thriller da antologia. Luther Whitney è un vero artista del furto, nessuna cassaforte o serratura può resistergli, ma ormai sta diventando anziano e ha deciso di ritirarsi dopo un ultimo colpo. Deve però fare i conti con un imprevisto perché la padrona della casa che Luther ha deciso di svaligiare non è partita con il marito, per intrattenersi con il suo amante che non è altri che il Presidente degli Stati Uniti. Quando la donna muore, la polizia prova a insabbiare il caso, ma per farlo occorre far tacere l'unico testimone. Eastwood e Hackman di nuovo uno contro l'altro, come ne "Gli spietati".

Quinn Harris, una giovane infermiera, scarica sul suo smartphone una app che afferma di predire il minuto esatto della morte di ognuno e scopre di avere solamente due giorni di vita. programme.title: Un giorno di ordinaria follia
programme.desc: Viaggio allucinato nella follia omicida di un uomo qualunque con Michael Douglas. Il quarantenne William Foster non sta passando un momento facile: lasciato dalla moglie e allontanato dalla figlia in seguito a un'ordinanza del giudice, viene preso da un raptus. Intrappolato in un ingorgo stradale, perde completamente la testa e comincia a uccidere chiunque gli capiti a tiro. Le sue gesta violente fanno il giro della città e del caso viene incaricato un detective (Robert Duvall) al suo ultimo giorno di servizio. Dal regista di "Linea mortale", Joel Schumacher.

programme.title: Miller's Girl
programme.desc: Miller's Girl.

programme.title: C'eravamo tanto amati
programme.desc: Nino Manfredi, Vittorio Gassman e Stefania Sandrelli nel capolavoro di Ettore Scola. La storia di tre amici, ex partigiani, sullo sfondo dell'Italia dal Dopoguerra agli anni 70. Dopo la fine del conflitto Gianni, Antonio e Nicola (Stefano Satta Flores) hanno preso strade diverse: Antonio fa il portantino e Nicola il professore, mentre Gianni è l’unico dei tre che è riuscito a fare carriera. Dopo molti anni, per caso, i tre si incontrano nuovamente. Sceneggiatura dello stesso Scola, con Age & Scarpelli, breve cameo di Vittorio De Sica, scomparso prima dell’uscita del film nelle sale.

programme.title: Amore, bugie e calcetto
programme.desc: Divertente commedia con Claudio Bisio, Claudia Pandolfi, Giuseppe Battiston e Angela Finocchiaro. Sette inseparabili amici si trovano a cambiare ruolo sia in campo che nella vita.

programme.title: Quello che non so di te
programme.desc: Commedia romantica, dal romanzo di Jenny B. Jones. Sul volo per l'Irlanda, una giovane violinista newyorkese incontra un divo del cinema. Benche' molto diversi, tra i due nascera' l'amore.

programme.title: Moglie e marito
programme.desc: Fioccano gli equivoci nella commedia con Pierfrancesco Favino e Kasia Smutniak. Andrea e' un affermato neurochirurgo, sua moglie Sofia una conduttrice televisiva: sono sposati, hanno due figli ma il loro rapporto attraversa una crisi nera. Non riescono proprio a capire le reciproche difficolta', almeno fino a quando non ci mette lo zampino il destino: un esperimento scientifico riuscito male scaraventa l'uno nel corpo dell'altra innescando una serie di momenti imbarazzanti ma molto divertenti. Andrea e Sofia scopriranno nella pratica cosa significa vivere nei panni del partner.

programme.title: La rivolta delle ex
programme.desc: Matthew McConaughey e Jennifer Garner in una commedia romantica dal tocco soprannaturale. Connor Mead è un celebre fotografo che ha un enorme fascino sulle donne: nessuna riesce a resistergli, e lui da cinico playboy passa da un'avventura all'altra. Per lui non esistono relazioni stabili, tanto meno il matrimonio. E di questo cerca di convincere anche il fratello minore, che invece sta per sposarsi, ma i fantasmi delle sue numerose ex cominciano a perseguitarlo, mostrandogli quello che sarà il suo futuro. Nel cast, anche Michael Douglas.

programme.title: Endless
programme.desc: Teen-movie paranormale di Scott Speer. L’unione degli innamorati Riley e Chris viene spezzata da un incidente d’auto. Rimasta in vita, Riley si convince che Chris la contatti dall'Aldilà.

Adam scopre che suo padre (Kevin Kline) ha sedotto la sua fidanzata. Davanti a un simile trauma, il ragazzo si ubriaca e finisce a casa di Emma. I due, amici di lunga data, finiscono a letto insieme e decidono di instaurare una relazione puramente fisica, senza alcun coinvolgimento: ci si diverte ma i sentimenti devono esser tenuti ben lontani. Un reciproco accordo che sembra anche funzionare, ma sara' sempre piu' difficile tenere a bada il cuore...

La messa in scena del playboy si complica pero' quando la donna gli presenta sua sorella Florence, la quale e' costretta veramente a vivere su una sedia a rotelle. Christian Grey riesce a riconquistare la fiducia di Anastasia, ma la nuova vita amorosa della coppia sara' minacciata dall'oscuro passato del miliardario, perche' Christian non riesce a disinnescare le sue pulsioni da dominatore. A rendere ancora piu' torbida la situazione ci pensera' l'ingresso in scena di Leila Williams, l'ossessiva ex-fidanzata di Grey, e di Elena Lincoln (Kim Basinger), la donna che inizio' Grey ai piaceri del sadomaso.

programme.title: Walk of Art: Walk of Art: Doha's Cultural Landscape
programme.desc: We explore how art has influenced the cultural landscape of Qatar and how it can be an immersive experience for those who visit, live and work there. We meet designers and artists who reflect the country's layers of creativity, cultural diversity and modern identity. They guide us through Doha's open-air gallery, taking us to the public artwork that inspires them the most and represents a milestone in Qatar's artistic evolution. From Doha Mountains and Cesar's Pouce to remembering Qatar's pearl diving heritage and the first artistic landmark - the Museum of Islamic Art.

programme.title: Ghost Adventures S1 ep 5
programme.desc: A clairvoyant repairman fearful of ghosts is forced to help them cross over so they can leave him in peace. On his journey of helping these ghosts with their unfinished businesses, he ends up getting into trouble with their families, friends and the community they are all living in. Will he be able to get these ghosts and their love ones, at the same time face his fear of them?

programme.title: Sari Saring Sine: Beloved
programme.desc: Friendship takes a violent turn when Adora (played by Nora Aunor) finds that she's a pawn in the intriguing games in life and love being played by her employer and close friend Renee (played by Hilda Koronel.).

programme.desc: Janet and Ian started a simple life together, but will their maried life be as happy as they dreamed to be when both their parents treat each other as enemy?

programme.desc: A Sari-Sari Original Series. Hot off the heels from her last cold case, investigative journalist Christine Del Mundo (Maui Taylor) is back with a brand new cold case. This time, it involves actress Bea Montenegro, whose death has only brought forth one suspect - a fellow model who suffers from face blindness.

Both women want to get out of their current realities, so they decide to switch lives by pretending to be each other.

Both women want to get out of their current realities, so they decide to switch lives by pretending to be each other.

programme.title: He's Just Not That Into You
programme.desc: A group of interconnected Baltimore-based twenty and thirtysomethings navigate their various relationships from the shallow end of the dating pool through the deep murky waters of married life trying to read the signs of the opposite sex - and hoping to be the exceptions to the no-exceptions rule. Gigi just wants a man who says he'll call - and does - while Alex advises her to stop sitting by the phone. Beth wonders if she should call it off after years of committed singlehood with her boyfriend Neil but he doesn't think there's a single thing wrong with their unmarried life. Janine's not sure if she can trust her husband Ben who can't quite trust himself around Anna. Anna can't decide between the sexy married guy or her straightforward no-sparks standby Conor who can't get over the fact that he can't have her. And Mary who's found an entire network of loving supportive men just needs to find one who's straight.

programme.title: Blood Diamond
programme.desc: Academy Award nominees Leonardo DiCaprio and Djimon Hounsou join Academy Award winner Jennifer Connelly in this action drama from Ed Zwick, the filmmaker behind The Last Samurai. DiCaprio stars as Danny Archer, a mercenary smuggler searching for a priceless diamond amid the chaos of Sierra Leone's civil war; Hounsou (Gladiator), as a desperate father searching for his lost son; and Connelly (A Beautiful Mind), as a reporter searching for the truth behind the trade in 'conflict diamonds.' Forced to confront the brutal human cost of the diamond trade, Archer changes his search for financial reward to a quest for redemption.
